script.problem: The one line is more than one sentence.

terra.problem: “Disciples Sent Ahead” does not establish that the departure happened at Bethsaida; Bethsaida was their destination. Also, Mark 6:45-46 does not mention the five thousand eating. Include verse 44 if retaining that detail.
“A Blind Man Healed” says Jesus touched the man’s eyes twice. Mark 8:23 says Jesus spit on his eyes and placed His hands on him; only the second placing of hands is explicitly said to be on his eyes.
“Home of Philip, Andrew, and Peter” correctly identifies Bethsaida as their hometown, but John 1:43-45 does not say Jesus called Philip or Philip found Nathanael there.
“Woe to Bethsaida” reports Jesus’ words accurately, but Matthew 11:20-22 does not say He spoke them at Bethsaida.
